summary: The primary apparent body-width field is selected and summarized at specimen level with explicit missingness, while legacy EDT fields are retained separately. Acceptance is conditional because the retained RC6 report metadata references RC5 artifacts, preventing complete confirmation that report field selection and displayed width summaries belong to the reviewed evidence package.

findings.title: Report metadata does not bind the primary width outputs to the reviewed candidate
findings.impact: Specimen-level width summaries and report field selection cannot be fully accepted as reproducible because the RC6 metadata and consistency record point to RC5 artifacts.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/01_biological_results/data/report_consistency_validation.json:7-10 contains hashes for the referenced artifacts.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the report metadata and consistency validation against the reviewed candidate, then independently verify specimen_summary.csv, width missingness, legacy-field exclusion, and all downstream report formats.

limitations: No full image-stack execution was performed.
The available retained evidence contains one specimen per group, so no biological group inference is available.
This statistics/reporting review does not independently validate contour geometry.
recommended_follow_up: Issue a superseding audit run after correcting report provenance and validating all primary body-width report fields against the corrected candidate artifacts.
